config.grain_rationale: One record is one current Australian credit licence issued by ASIC to one licensee. The business participant is the licensee named in CRED_LIC_NAME, whose attributes (ABN/ACN, locality/state/postcode) are carried on the same row. The record's own identity is the licence number (CRED_LIC_NUM), not a business identifier, so it is not mapped to any entity field.

record_id.rationale: CRED_LIC_NUM is present on 100% of rows and distinct on all 464 discovery rows (464/464), matching the 6-digit credit licence number shape. Unique per licence, hence per record.

fields.rationale: ASIC issues credit licences to legal persons; this column names the licensee (the holder), which is the registered legal name. Values are all-caps with legal-form suffixes (PTY LTD, LIMITED, PTY. LTD.), consistent with a register of legal names. Some holders are natural persons (e.g. 'TSIALTAS, ARGIRIOS HARRY'); the raw name is preserved because that is how the register records the licensee.

CRED_LIC_BN is the registered business name under which the licensee trades, distinct from the legal name (e.g. LUNAWAVE PTY. LIMITED trades as DISCOVERY FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT). Present on 34.5% of discovery rows, blank elsewhere. Explicitly a business name, so trading_name not legal_name.

One combined ABN/ACN column. 90.5% of 11-digit discovery values pass the ABN checksum; 13 rows hold '0' as a placeholder for 'no identifier'. The regex_extract step gates the rule to 11-digit values only, so rows holding a 9-digit ACN (or a 7-8 digit short value) are skipped here rather than raising ABN_LENGTH errors - this removed the 8.7% holdout error rate. The abn transform then enforces checksum validity.

27 discovery rows carry 9-digit values in the combined column, i.e. an ACN rather than an ABN; a few further rows have 7-8 digits which the acn transform zero-pads. The regex_extract step gates the rule to 7-9 digit values only, so the 11-digit ABN rows are skipped rather than raising ACN_LENGTH errors - this removed the 90.0% holdout error rate. ACN is never derived by truncating an 11-digit ABN. The acn transform enforces the checksum.
Suburb/locality of the licensee's address; 100% present, 314 distinct on discovery, values match AU suburb names (SYDNEY, MELBOURNE, PARRAMATTA, LEONGATHA).
2-3 letter Australian state abbreviations, 8 distinct, fully within the state enum (NSW/VIC/QLD/WA/SA/TAS/ACT/NT).
All 464 discovery values are 4-digit shapes matching AU postcodes.

constants.rationale: ASIC Australian credit licence register; all state values are Australian jurisdictions and all postcodes are AU. Evident from metadata plus the state and postcode columns.

unmapped.reason: Constant label 'Credit Licence' on every row (1 distinct value); identifies the register, not the entity or its industry. Carries no ANZSIC code, so it cannot populate entity.industry_code.
The credit licence number - the identifier of the record/licence itself, not a business identifier. Used only as record_id.

The date the CREDIT LICENCE commenced (dd/mm/yyyy, 100% present), not the date the legal entity was registered or incorporated. Mapping a licence effective date to entity.date_registered conflates two distinct concepts and would assert a fact the source does not state, so it is left unmapped. The ontology has no licence-start target.
Empty on 100% of discovery rows. It is the licence end date, which dates the licence claim, not the entity's name, form or address.
Status of the LICENCE (APPR = approved), not of the legal entity. A licence status must not become entity.status, so it is left unmapped rather than mapped as 'active'.
Free-text licence enforcement/history narrative (present on 0.2% of rows, e.g. 'Licensee contravenes a licence condition ...'). Licence event prose, not a structured entity field.

The column itself is mapped twice (to entity.abn and entity.acn) via mutually exclusive regex shape gates; it is listed here only to record that '0' on 13 discovery rows is a placeholder for 'no identifier' and yields no observation.
Australian Financial Services licence number; '0' on 425/464 discovery rows. Another licence identifier, not an entity attribute; the ontology has no field for it.
Latitude of the licence address. The ontology has no coordinate target; concatenating it into address.full would corrupt the address.
Longitude of the licence address. No coordinate target in the ontology; see CRED_LIC_LAT.
External dispute resolution scheme memberships (AFCA/COSL/FOS, '~'-separated). A licence attribute with no ontology target.

Free-text prose describing what the licence authorises ('This licence authorises the licensee to:~...'), identical in structure across rows with only 7 distinct values. A licence attribute, not a structured entity field.

Also considered for entity.entity_type. Declined: the register states no business form, so the suffix heuristic (PTY LTD -> company, a comma-separated personal name -> sole_trader) would be inference rather than a stated fact, and 'sole trader' in particular is not established by a name alone (the person could operate through a company or trust). entity_type is left unmapped so it stays 'unknown' rather than being guessed.

config.notes: Held-out fix: the two identifier rules previously both fired on every non-empty CRED_LIC_ABN_ACN value, so each reported the other shape as a length error (ABN_LENGTH 8.7%, ACN_LENGTH 90.0%). Both rules now begin with a regex_extract shape gate (^\d{11}$ for ABN, ^\d{7,9}$ for ACN) that returns null instead of raising, making the rules mutually exclusive. On discovery this took both error rates to 0.0% with unchanged emission counts (420 ABN, 31 ACN); no identifier is silently dropped, and ACN is never obtained by truncating an ABN. Also moved CRED_LIC_START_DT (licence commencement) off entity.date_registered per critic. observed_at uses resource_last_modified because the file carries no stated-as-of date. Values in the file are all-caps as published; case is not altered.
